metadata.description: A pixel-art Claude who works beside your Claude Code session: he reads, searches, types, runs, thinks and writes along with the spinner, wanders the status row while idle, and sleeps when you do. Plus the chip status line he lives on.

plugins.name: mize-coworker
plugins.description: Claude as a small coworker in the terminal: an orange pixel-art Claude, two rows tall, in 73 frames. While a turn runs he sits beside the spinner in a scene for every spinner word (a thought bubble, a pen on a notepad, a book, a magnifying glass over text or over a globe, a laptop, a terminal, his own small helpers, a gear, a scroll for a skill, a plug for an MCP call); idle on the status row he breathes, blinks, strolls, yawns and sips a coffee, sweats near a full context and sleeps frosted once the prompt cache goes cold. The spinner word says what is happening (Reading register.ts, Running npm), and /coworker demo plays every animation once. Draws only; nothing reaches the model.
